-- agg_by_column
with base_geral as (
  select
      *
  from (
    select
        case
          when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição' then embossing_expedition_date
          when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente' then card_acquired_at
          else fis_reference_date
        end as view_ref_date
      , a.*
      , identifier(:p_agg_by) as agg_by
      -- , case when c.ar_code is not null then 'AR Cortado' else 'AR Normal' end as ar_status -- <========================================
    from self_service_analytics.logistics_tracking a
    -- left join delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_trimmed_number` as c -- <========================================
      -- using (ar_code) -- <========================================
  )
  where 1=1
    and case when array_contains(:p_delivery_product, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_delivery_product, delivery_product) end
    and identifier(:p_agg_by) is not null
    and case when array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, issue_reason_name) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_region, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_region, region) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_card_variant, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_card_variant, variant) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_card_model, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_card_model, card_model) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_bank, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_bank, org_name) end
    and case when array_contains(:segment_base, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:segment_base, segment_base) end
    -- and array_contains(:p_ar_status, ar_status) -- <=======================================
)

, base_consolidada as (
  select
    case
      when :date_view = 'Dia' then date_format(view_ref_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
      when :date_view = 'Semana' then date(date_trunc('week', view_ref_date))
      when :date_view = 'Trimestre' then date(date_trunc('quarter', view_ref_date))
      else date_format(view_ref_date, 'y-MM')
    end as view_ref_date
  , org_name as banco
  , delivery_product as canal_de_entrega
  , issue_reason_name as motivo_de_emissao
  , variant as variante
  -- , ar_status
  , region as regiao
  , agg_by
  , state as uf
  , count(distinct fis_ar_code) as total
  , count(distinct case when status_delivery = 'Entregue' and array_contains(:p_range, class_du_collect_delivery) then fis_ar_code else null end) as entregue
  from base_geral
  where view_ref_date between date(:p_date_range.min) and date(:p_date_range.max)
  group by all
)

, base_efetividade_6_meses as (
  select
    agg_by,
    round(
      count(distinct case
        when status_delivery = 'Entregue' 
             and array_contains(:p_range, class_du_collect_delivery) 
        then fis_ar_code end) 
      / count(distinct fis_ar_code), 4) as efe_seis_meses
    from base_geral
  where 1=1
    and view_ref_date between date_format(dateadd(month, -6, :p_date_range.max), 'yyyy-MM-01') and last_day(dateadd(month, -1, :p_date_range.max))
  group by all
)

select 
  a.*,
  avg(b.efe_seis_meses) as media_efe_seis_meses
from base_consolidada a
left join base_efetividade_6_meses b
  using (agg_by)
  group by all

  from base
  where 1=1
  group by all
),

  select
    agg_by
    , view_ref_date
    , delivery_product
    , count(distinct case when delivery_company = 'Correios' and (card_unblock_date is not null or was_activated) and array_contains(:p_range, faixa) then fis_ar_code else null end) as total_cartoes_entregues
  from base
  where 1=1
  group by all
),

total_card_collect_mes as (
  select
    agg_by
    , view_ref_date
    , delivery_product
    , count(distinct fis_ar_code) as total_cartoes
  from base
  where 1=1
  group by all
),

ativacao_acumulada as ( 
    select
      SUM(ativacao) over (partition by view_ref_date, agg_by order by faixa) as ativacao_acumulados,
    *
    from faixa_ativacao
    where 1=1
),

total_acumulado_entregue as (
  select
    SUM(total_cartoes_entregues) over (partition by view_ref_date, agg_by order by view_ref_date) as card_acumulados_entregues,
    *
  from total_card_entregues_mes
  where 1=1
),

total_acumulado as (
  select
    SUM(total_cartoes) over (partition by view_ref_date, agg_by order by view_ref_date) as card_acumulados_coletados,
    *
  from total_card_collect_mes
  where 1=1
)

select 
  ea.view_ref_date
  , ea.faixa
  , ea.agg_by
  , sum(ativacao_acumulados) as ativacao
  , sum(card_acumulados_coletados) as total_coletados
  , sum(card_acumulados_entregues) as total_entregues
  , round(sum(ativacao_acumulados) / sum(card_acumulados_coletados), 4) as ativ_collect
  , round(sum(ativacao_acumulados) / sum(card_acumulados_entregues), 4) as ativ_entregue
from ativacao_acumulada ea
left join total_acumulado ta
  on ea.view_ref_date = ta.view_ref_date and ea.agg_by = ta.agg_by
left join total_acumulado_entregue te
  on ea.view_ref_date = te.view_ref_date and ea.agg_by = te.agg_by
where
  case when :p_tipo = 'Geral' then ea.delivery_product = 'Correios'
  else ea.agg_by = :p_tipo end
group by all

        , case when count(distinct bigint(a.hawb_code)) > 1 then count(distinct bigint(a.hawb_code)) - 1 else 0 end as reenvios
      from card_operations.tracking_card_delivery a
      left join self_service_analytics.logistics_tracking b
        using (ar_code)
      where a.delivery_company = 'FLASH'

  where 1=1
    and identifier(:p_agg_by) is not null

    and case when array_contains(:p_delivery_product, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_delivery_product, delivery_product) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, issue_reason_name) end

    and case when array_contains(:p_card_variant, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_card_variant, variant) end

    and case when array_contains(:segment_base, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:segment_base, segment_base) end
  group by all
),

base_flash as (
  select 
    *
  from reenvios_flash
  where reenvios > 0
),

base_mobi as (
  select
    date_format(view_ref_date, 'yyyy-MM') as view_ref_date
    , case when :p_tipo = 'Geral' then 'Geral' else identifier(:p_agg_by) end as agg_by
    , status_delivery
    , ar_code
    , max(linha) as reenvios
  from (
    select
      case
        when :view_ref = 'Expedição'     then b.embossing_expedition_date
        when :view_ref = 'Cliente'       then date(b.card_acquired_at)
        when :view_ref = 'Último status' then date(a.last_status_at)
        end as view_ref_date
      , row_number() over (partition by a.ar_code, a.last_status, a.consumer_id order by a.last_status_at) as linha
      , b.status_delivery
      , b.ar_code
      , b.delivery_product
      , b.issue_reason_name
      , b.region
      , b.variant
      , b.account_type
      , b.segment_base
    from card_operations.tracking_card_delivery a
    left join self_service_analytics.logistics_tracking b
      using (ar_code)
    where 1=1
      and last_status = 'Tratativa entregar'
      and a.delivery_company = 'MOBI'
)

where 1=1
  and identifier(:p_agg_by) is not null
  and view_ref_date between :p_date_range.min and :p_date_range.max
  and case when array_contains(:p_delivery_product, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_delivery_product, delivery_product) end

  and case when array_contains(:p_card_variant, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_card_variant, variant) end
group by all
),

base_final as (
select
  coalesce(a.view_ref_date, b.view_ref_date) as view_ref_date
  , coalesce(a.agg_by, b.agg_by) as agg_by
  , coalesce(a.ar_code, b.ar_code) as ar_code
  , coalesce(a.status_delivery, b.status_delivery) as status_delivery
  -- , coalesce(v.qtde_vias, 0) as qtde_vias
  -- , coalesce(r.qtde_reenvios, 0) as qtde_reenvios
  , coalesce(a.reenvios, 0) + coalesce(b.reenvios, 0) as total
from base_flash a
full outer join base_mobi b
  using (ar_code)
)

select
  view_ref_date
  , agg_by
  , status_delivery
  , sum(total) as total
from base_final
group by all

    case
      when du_emb_finalizer_status <= 4  then 'a. Até 4'
      when du_emb_finalizer_status <= 7  then 'b. Até 7'

      when du_emb_finalizer_status <= 30 then 'e. Até 30'

      end as class_du_finalizer_status

      when du_customer_unblock <= 7  then 'b. Até 7'
      when du_customer_unblock <= 10 then 'c. Até 10'
      when du_customer_unblock <= 15 then 'd. Até 15'
      when du_customer_unblock <= 30 then 'e. Até 30'
      when du_customer_unblock > 30  then 'f. Acima de 30'
      end as classs_du_customer_unblock
  , case
      when du_emb_unblock <= 4  then 'a. Até 4'
      when du_emb_unblock <= 7  then 'b. Até 7'
      when du_emb_unblock <= 10 then 'c. Até 10'
      when du_emb_unblock <= 15 then 'd. Até 15'
      when du_emb_unblock <= 30 then 'e. Até 30'
      when du_emb_unblock > 30  then 'f. Acima de 30'
      end as class_du_emb_unblock
  , ar_code
    from self_service_analytics.logistics_tracking
    where 1=1
),

base_geral as (
  select
    date_format(view_ref_date, 'y-MM') as view_ref_date
    , faixa
    , case 
        when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente'   and faixa in ('a. Até 4', 'b. Até 7', 'c. Até 10') then 'Dentro do prazo'
        when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição' and faixa in ('a. Até 4', 'b. Até 7')              then 'Dentro do prazo'
        else 'Fora do prazo'
        end as check_faixa
    , case when :p_tipo = 'Geral' then 'Geral' else identifier(:p_agg_by) end as agg_by
    , delivery_product
    , case 
        when delivery_product in ('Flash', 'Mobi') then 'Malha'
        when delivery_product in ('Flash - Redespacho', 'Mobi - Redespacho') then 'Redespacho'
        end as delivery_product_agg
    , count(distinct case when finalizer_status_date is not null then fis_ar_code else null end) as total_finalizadora
    , count(distinct case when finalizer_status_date is not null and array_contains(:p_range, faixa) then fis_ar_code else null end) as data_finalizadora

    , count(distinct case when status_delivery = 'Entregue' then fis_ar_code else null end) as total_entregue
    , count(distinct case when status_delivery = 'Entregue' and array_contains(:p_range, faixa) then fis_ar_code else null end) as entregue

    , count(distinct case when delivery_product = 'Correios' and card_unblock_date is not null then fis_ar_code else null end) as total_correios
    , count(distinct case when delivery_product = 'Correios' and card_unblock_date is not null and array_contains(:p_range, faixa) then fis_ar_code else null end) as entregue_correios
  from (
    select
        case
          when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição' then embossing_expedition_date
          when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente'   then date(card_acquired_at)
          else fis_reference_date
        end as view_ref_date,
        case
          when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente'   and :sla_type = 'Entrega'   then class_du_customer_delivery
          when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente'   and :sla_type = 'Serviço'   then class_du_finalizer_status

          when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição' and :sla_type = 'Entrega'   then class_du_collect_delivery
          when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição' and :sla_type = 'Serviço'   then class_du_finalizer_status

          when :p_view_ref = 'Cliente'    and :sla_type = 'Correios' then classs_du_customer_unblock -- Correios
          when :p_view_ref = 'Expedição'  and :sla_type = 'Correios' then class_du_emb_unblock      -- Correios
          end as faixa
      , *
    from self_service_analytics.logistics_tracking
    left join faixa using (ar_code)
    where 1=1 
  )
  where 1=1 
    and view_ref_date between date(:p_date_range.min) and date(:p_date_range.max)
    and case when array_contains(:p_card_variant, 'Todos')      then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_card_variant, variant) end
    and case when array_contains(:delivery_product, 'Todos')    then 1=1 else array_contains(:delivery_product, delivery_product) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, 'Todos') then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_issue_reason_name, issue_reason_name) end
    and case when array_contains(:p_region, 'Todos')            then 1=1 else array_contains(:p_region, region) end
    and case when array_contains(:segment_base, 'Todos')        then 1=1 else array_contains(:segment_base, segment_base) end
  group by all
)

select
    *

  -- SLA Entrega
  , case when delivery_product <> 'Correios' then sum(total_entregue) over (partition by view_ref_date, agg_by) end as total_ac_entrega
  , case when delivery_product <> 'Correios' then sum(entregue)       over (partition by view_ref_date, agg_by order by faixa rows unbounded preceding) end as entregue_ac_entrega

   -- SLA Entrega - Malha e Redespacho

lines:
#### SLA de entrega
 

ℹ️  **Conceito:** De tudo que entregamos, quanto tempo levou?

ℹ️ Para esse cálculo, filtramos todos os cartões que foram entregues 
   - *Coluna status_delivery = 'Entregue'*

ℹ️ A partir disso, é realizado o cálculo de dias úteis entre **data de solicitação do cartão** ou **data de expedição** (vai depender do que estiver no filtro '📈Visão') até a **data de entrega**

#### SLA de serviço
 

ℹ️  **Conceito:** De tudo que vendemos, quanto tempo a Courier levou para "concluir" o serviço?

ℹ️ Para esse bloco de Serviço, utilizamos alguns status finalizadores do cartão sendo: Entregue, custodiado ou sinistrado

ℹ️ Para esse cálculo, filtramos todos os cartões que estão com um desses três status "finalizadores" acima. Após isso, é realizado o cálculo de dias úteis entre **data de expedição** (aqui o filtro '📈Visão' **não é aplicado**) até a **data de finalização do cartão**

# 🚫 Custódia - Bloqueios definitivos
Bloqueios: 

**E** ⭢ Extravio; **F** ⭢ Fraude/Falsa; **G** ⭢ Substituição; **M** ⭢ Falecimento; **N** ⭢ Fraude - Bloqueio POC; **P** ⭢ Perda; **R** ⭢ Roubo; **U** ⭢ Cancelamento do cartão; **Y** ⭢ Renegociação.

# 💳 Custódia - Visão atual

**Visão atual** ⭢ Relativa à última vez que o cartão entrou em custódia.

Estão disponíveis visualizações de volume de custódia, Malha (Flash, Mobi), Redespacho (Flash-Redespacho , Mobi-Redespacho ) e as mesmas visualizações segmentadas pelo tipo de via.
